sections.text: Native estimates represent the same `chain_ni.xml` CRAM-48 solve without Python/PyO3 overhead. Generate fresh artifacts with `cargo bench -p nucleide-depletion --bench depletion_bench -- depletion_ni_chain`.

Native cram48_solve: read `target/criterion/depletion_ni_chain/cram48_solve/new/estimates.json` (SHA-256 `a9387b44492a5e29904090260ce9ff0e3bf261ae2a4aa00d60578ef0190abe2c`). The container reads these host benchmark artifacts; it does not execute the Rust benchmark itself.

Native deplete_end_to_end: read `target/criterion/depletion_ni_chain/deplete_end_to_end/new/estimates.json` (SHA-256 `7963cce607844963ac369e938569629653fa1a7f60079ebaa1b0bdd2a7829103`). The container reads these host benchmark artifacts; it does not execute the Rust benchmark itself.
